questions.text: Which famous fast-food catchphrase is most closely tied to french fries?
questions.explanation: The iconic line "You want fries with that?" has long been associated with fast-food culture, specifically McDonald's, as a prompt from cashiers to upsell customers on an order of french fries.

questions.text: Which fast-food chain prominently labels its french fries as 'World Famous Fries' on its packaging?
questions.explanation: McDonald's is the fast-food chain most strongly associated with french fries, and the term 'World Famous Fries' is directly printed on their fry packaging and used in their advertising.
